title.narrative: Integrated response to GBV/protection in Moretna Jiru, Minjar Shenkora woredas in North Shewa zone, and Fagta Lakoma, Jawi, Ayehu Guagusa woredas in Awi zone

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtUnder this project, a total of 21,485 individuals will be served over a 12‑month period from 23 July 2025 to 22 July 2026. This project intends to respond to Priority of GBV response and preventions with the alignment of protection in integrated manner which targets vulnerable populations in Amhara Region north Shewa zone Moretenajiru and Minjarshinkora woredas and Awi zone, Fagta Lakoma, Jawi, Ayehu Guagusa woredas aim at responding to all the prioritized activities in allocated budget 100% of GBV response and prevention. The target woredas are currently conflict affected areas and the communities have suffered by influx of IDPs from nearby area and security instability because conflict between federal government and armed group ‘fano’ forcing the communities to lead a difficult living condition and exposing multiple burden and violence GBV and different protection concern. In response to the above problems, this project is proposed by EOC-DICAC who has a long -standing presence within the affected communities and strong cluster presence. The Ethiopian Orthodox Church Development and inter church Aid Commission aim is to address the immediate needs of IDPs and host communities through GBV prevention and response service provision. It also aims, protection of vulnerable women/girls through strengthening/establishing of women/Girls friendly spaces, GBV awareness creation and case management referral pathway strengthening with active engagement of religious and traditional leaders in the awareness creation activities. ltbrgtlt/pgt
